notes: PCIe: a 2 s sampler across the entire M4A window recorded both links at 8 GT/s (Gen3) during all cold prefills and decodes; Gen1 (2.5 GT/s) occurs only in the idle state after a model load (load/unload fingerprint, see 2026-11-19 report). The unified pool is pre-reserved at boot (headroom identical at 167K and 232K); per-slot caps are accounting gates. Over-cap requests (269K/291K/317K) were rejected with clean 400s; no corruption in any window. The 48K/24K/8K fixtures with the planted-code question produced deterministic zero-token generations (first sample EOS, 4/4); their prefill/cached timings are valid, their decode is not measured. Production P1 (non-unified 256K/2) remained live before, between, and after all windows.
